title: 7,500 Light-Years From Earth, A Cat’s Head Appears - Nautilus

text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementAstronomy7,500 Light-Years From Earth, A Cat’s Head AppearsA beautiful new NASA image of the Carina NebulaDNBy David Nield7:00 AM CST on November 5, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleLooking at the images NASA just published from its Hubble and James Webb Space telescopes, you’d think part of the Carina Nebula was haunted. The vast cloud of gas and dust in these images resembles a cat sitting upright, with an eerily glowing eye.It’s called the Cat’s Head Nebula, a piece of the Carina Nebula that, while not newly discovered, has been newly zoomorphized and nicknamed. It’s around 7,500 light-years away from Earth, carved out over eons by intense ultraviolet radiation and winds from the massive stars that call this region of the universe home.A visible light image from the Hubble Telescope.
